newsitem.title: UK: Four stowaways caught on channel tunnel train.
newsitem.headline: Four stowaways caught on channel tunnel train.

text.p: Four stowaways were found hidden under a Eurostar train after surviving the journey under the English Channel from France, police said on Wednesday.
They were discovered in an inspection hatch underneath the train when Eurostar staff heard them tapping.

The train halted at the southern English town of Ashford, its last stop before London after passing through the Channel Tunnel. "It is the first time this has happened," a Eurostar spokesman said. "I am not aware of any injuries. They were taken away by police.".
Passengers said they were told the stowaways were Moldovans but their nationality could not be confirmed by police who were questioning them.
